summary: A quick, tense bidding game where players simultaneously commit coins to taverns, then draft dwarves in descending bid order, gradually assembling a scoring army across five character classes. Its clever twist is that spent coins upgrade in value, so early sacrifices can pay off in later rounds.
praised: simple, elegant bidding mechanism that stays tense throughout
fast playtime with real decision weight each round
charming, high-quality dwarf miniatures and production
criticised: outcomes can feel swingy based on what's available to bid on
limited strategic depth once the bidding pattern is learned
some player-count dependent downtime during simultaneous reveals

interaction.kind: simultaneous sealed bidding and drafting from shared taverns
interaction.detail: Every round players bid directly against each other for the same pool of cards, and bid order determines who gets first pick, so opponents' choices constantly reshape what's left for you. The taverns are fully shared state, while each player's growing army of dwarves is their own private tableau.

subsystems: Dwarf-class army scoring (five distinct formulas: blacksmiths, warriors, rangers, miners, mercenaries/heroes)
scoring.how_you_win: After 3 reigns of bidding coins to recruit dwarves into your army, each of the five character classes is scored by its own rule and the totals (plus leftover coin value) are summed; the highest total wins.
